description: This file defines an interface and a class for creating MySQL database connections within a backend API. The class constructs connection strings based on environment options, including parsing optional MySQL URLs and configuration parameters.

classes.name: IMySqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Interface declaring a method to create a database connection.

classes.name: MySqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Implements connection creation logic, using configuration options and URL parsing.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MySqlConnection based on configured options.

methods.name: TryParsePort
methods.description: Tries to parse a port number from a string.

methods.name: ParseMysqlUrl
methods.description: Parses a MySQL connection URL into host, port, and database components.
